picks.name: Dele Sosimi (feat. brekkyt & Meith)
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Wah Wah 45s. Similar Afrobeat/broken-beat territory to your Alex Nut/Eglo picks.
picks.bio: Fela Kuti/Egypt 80 alum, now a UK Afrobeat stalwart. "Remixed 2026" (August 27, 2026) is a hand-stamped 12" on Wah Wah 45s -- two new reworks from his album "You No Fit Touch Am": brekkyt reshapes the title track with a bruk-and-bass focus, while Meith takes "Sanctuary" into deeper Afro-tech territory.
picks.why_listen: Afrobeat roots filtered through UK broken beat and bass production -- good connective tissue between your Afrobeat-adjacent picks and your bass/club material.

picks.name: Brian d'Souza (Auntie Flo)
picks.source_note: Already in your library as Auntie Flo.
picks.bio: Already in your library as Auntie Flo. "Music To Watch Seeds Grow By 007: Brian d'Souza (Sunflowers)" (February 19, 2026) is a 7-track ambient album on Ransom Note's Seeds cassette series, drawing on botanical research into how sunflowers interact and compete beneath the soil.
picks.why_listen: A fully ambient, ego-free side of an artist you know for club-facing global house -- good texture for an opening set or a wind-down.

release.title: Music To Watch Seeds Grow By 007: Brian d'Souza (Sunflowers)
